Welcome to my personal website, built with Quarto and published through GitHub Pages.
This site collects a short introduction, selected work, a data visualization example, and a reflection on using GenAI as a learning partner.

## About Me

I am a SIT student developing my skills in data engineering, visualization, software development, and applied problem solving.
I enjoy building practical systems, learning new tools, and turning messy ideas into clear, usable outputs.

## Current Focus

- Strengthening my foundations in data structures, algorithms, and visualization.
- Practicing reproducible technical writing with Quarto Markdown.
- Building small projects that connect programming concepts to real use cases.
- Learning how to use GitHub and GitHub Pages for sharing work professionally.
